title: no guard checks what the register renders into docs/reference, so internal notes reached user-facing help and MCP descriptions
body:
Found by ic on 2026-09-24 in the 3.2.1 doc audit's register sweep.

Seen: the register's argument notes and help texts carried internal material -- Rust paths, rulings, node names, dates, AC ids and maintainers' all-caps argument -- into user-facing surfaces: the argument notes render only into `docs/reference`, while the help texts and `when_to_use` also reach `--help` and the MCP tool descriptions. ic confirmed 25 such rows at their JSON paths. They survived because no guard scans what renders into `docs/reference`: `no_pm_state_in_output.rs` scans `--help` only, and only for thread, work-package, criterion and test ids and issue numbers.

Expected: a check over every surface the register renders into, for what a user-facing text must not carry.

Disposition: vc, 2026-09-24 -- the 25 rows are rewritten in the 3.2.1 audit's register landing; the guard is new development and is filed for after the stabilisation line.


Fixed in 3.2.2 by `87ec19cf7` (vc, 2026-09-25): the commit message names the bank, its patch-id and the judge.
